text: dsh-cherry-kb 是面向 DSH Web 的知识库与记忆插件，在对话输入栏添加知识库选择和三档记忆切换按钮，并在设置页提供「我的知识库」与 Cherry Studio 知识库页面。它通过宿主路由调用本机已有的记忆开关、索引和 Cherry 命令行工具，不自行实现索引或记忆。用户可选择对话检索来源、查看或添加来源、启动索引更新、管理每来源记忆和本地模型，也可浏览并试搜 Cherry Studio 知识库。适合希望在 DSH Web 对话中使用本地资料和已有 Cherry 知识库的人；需预先安装本地工具链并配置其路径。

dsh-cherry-kb adds source and memory controls to the DSH Web composer, with settings for local and Cherry Studio libraries. It calls local tools for memory and indexing. Users can choose sources, update indexes, and search Cherry libraries. The local knowledge-base toolchain is required.
想让 DSH Web 对话检索我本机的知识库
能不能在每个对话里选择要用哪些资料来源
我想在聊天输入框旁边切换记忆模式
怎样从设置页把一个本地文件夹加入知识库来源
需要查看或试搜 Cherry Studio 已建好的知识库
Let me choose which local knowledge sources a DSH conversation can retrieve from.
I want a memory mode switch beside the chat composer.
Show and search my existing Cherry Studio knowledge bases in DSH Web.
dsh-cherry-kb 的功能「选择对话知识来源」：在输入栏旁打开知识库选择控件，可选择全部、单个或多个来源；选择会影响后续检索与来源记忆注入。
dsh-cherry-kb 的功能「切换记忆模式」：点击输入栏中的记忆控件，在全量、精简和关闭三种模式间切换，并显示当前状态。
dsh-cherry-kb 的功能「管理本地知识库」：设置页展示来源并提供目录选择、来源管理和一键索引更新等操作，后台通过已有 idx 工具处理索引。
dsh-cherry-kb 的功能「浏览 Cherry Studio 知识库」：独立设置页列出 Cherry Studio 知识库，允许选择对话可用的库并试搜；该页面提供只读访问。
dsh-cherry-kb 使用前须知：它不包含知识库引擎，必须先安装本机「我的知识库」工具链，并用 DSH_KB_ROOT 指向含 idx 的目录；否则相关路由无法运行。
dsh-cherry-kb 使用前须知：Cherry Studio 知识库页只读取和搜索现有库，不能在此插件内重建或改写 Cherry 数据。

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · dsh-cherry-kb：Local knowledge base and memory switch for **DeepSeek Harness** (`dsh web`).

Two controls in the composer's trailing tool row (left of the model selector),
and two pages under Settings. The host half orchestrates an external
knowledge-base toolchain; it re-implements neither indexing nor memory.

---

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · ⚠️ Read this first: external prerequisite：**This plugin is not self-contained.** It contains no chunking, no FTS, no
embedding, no `AGENTS.md` rendering and no memory logic. Every operation is a
`spawn` of three executables that already exist on your machine:

| Executable | Used for |
| --- | --- |
| `我的知识库/记忆开关` | reading and setting the three-position memory mode |
| `我的知识库/idx` | status, sources, indexing, search, embedding models, index library |
| `我的知识库/cherry` | read-only access to Cherry Studio's own knowledge bases |

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · ⚠️ Read this first: external prerequisite：The knowledge-base root is resolved in this order:

1. `DSH_KB_ROOT` (environment variable), or an explicit override;
2. otherwise `<built lib/>/../../../../我的知识库`, then one level further up.

The first candidate that actually contains an `idx` file wins.

**Without that toolchain installed**, the plugin still installs and renders, but
every route fails with a "cannot find the CLI" error. The package does not ship
the toolchain, and there is no public distribution of it.

---

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb
```

Point it at your knowledge base if it does not sit four levels above the
installed package:

```sh
DSH_KB_ROOT=/path/to/我的知识库 dsh web
```

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · What it registers：**Composer tool row** — slot `conversation.input.right`, both left of the model
selector as one cluster of "what this conversation gets to see":

| Seat id | Order | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kb-chat-kb` | 90 | Which knowledge base this conversation uses |
| `kb-memory` | 100 | Three-position memory switch (always shows the current position) |

**Settings** — slot `settings.section`:

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · What it registers：| Section id | Order | Role |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `my-knowledge-base` | 50 | Source list, native folder picker, one-click reindex with staged progress, index library, per-source memory, embedding-model picker, local model service |
| `cherry-studio-kb` | 55 | Read-only view of Cherry Studio's knowledge bases |

Both composer seats share one store, so the button and the settings page cannot
disagree about the current position.

**Host half** — 22 routes under `/dsh/kb/*`:

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · What it registers：```
status  toggle  update  progress  stop  token
sources  search  select  source-memory
indexes  index-delete  rebuild-vectors  models
model/service  model/list  model/loaded  model/load  model/unload

Routes that write require a token; `KbToken.ts` issues it to loopback
same-origin requests only.

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · Boundaries：- **Cherry Studio's bases are read-only.** They belong to another application;
  the plugin never builds, moves, rewrites or vacuums them. This is enforced by
  keeping the Cherry family in a separate module (`KbCherry.ts`) from the
  workspace family (`KbSources.ts`).
- **Adding a source registers it; it does not index it.** Confirming an add
  writes `我的知识库/03_证据层/来源清单.json` and nothing else.
- **The plugin never moves the memory switch on its own.** It is changed only by
  a user gesture in the UI.
- The plugin holds no persistent state of its own; every status shown is read
  live from the CLIs.

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · Verify：Both checks are offline — no `dsh` process, no browser, no network:

```sh
node scripts/verify-bundle.mjs   # client artifact + host route table
node scripts/verify-host.mjs     # route handlers against stub CLIs
```

`verify-host.mjs` runs entirely against bash stubs; it does not exercise the
real CLIs or the HTTP adapter layer. Read its closing note before treating a
green run as end-to-end coverage.

@wanghuiym123/dsh-cherry-kb README · Build：```sh
tsc -b tsconfig.json && tsc -b tsconfig.host.json   # types (client / host)
node <tsdown entry>                                  # lib/client.js + lib/index.js
```

The two `tsconfig` files are standalone on purpose: no `extends` into the dsh
checkout and no project references, so `tsc -b` never writes outside this
package.
